title: 1995 AMC 8 Problem 16
statement: Students from three middle schools worked on a summer project. Seven students from Allen School worked for \(3\) days. Four students from Balboa School worked for \(5\) days. Five students from Carver School worked for \(9\) days. The total amount paid for the students’ work was \(\$774.\) Assuming each student received the same amount for a day’s work, how much did the students from Balboa School earn altogether?

solutions.text:
The total student-days are \(7 \times 3 + 4 \times 5 + 5 \times 9\) \(= 21 + 20 + 45\) \(= 86.\)

So each student-day pays \(\$774 \div 86 = \$9.\) Balboa worked \(20\) student-days, earning \(20 \times \$9 = \$180.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Compute the total number of student-days worked across all three schools
Divide \(\$774\) by the total student-days to get the pay per student-day
